notes.title: Melancholy Republic now for sale!
notes.notes:
Hey

Melancholy Republic has been released and is available on Steam for GBP6.99! It took a little longer than expected, but we are so happy to finally share our vision with you all. Despite it being Friday the 13th(!) we are over the moon to be releasing and we can't wait for you all to play. 


Just a little note regarding menus/ saving: 

To save/menu access press Esc during gameplay
To swap between fullscreen/windowed mode press F5


Long live stories and single player games!

notes.title: Update on Release Time! Release imminent!
notes.notes:
This is a quick update for all! 

The game has been uploaded. Steam still need to complete the 'review' process. Unfortunately, I had forgotten that the game's Steam page still had some concept artwork in the images, because of this, the review process has been delayed. I am hoping it will be reviewed and ready to go today/tomorrow. Just to give you advance notice that the game might be late in the day tomorrow, or worst case scenario the day after. Apologies for not have a specific time for you, but it's within the next 24-48 hours! I'll keep you updated.

Thank you again for your ongoing patience, we can't wait for you to play!

notes.title: Melancholy Republic Releases on Wednesday!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thank you for your patience. Melancholy Republic will be releasing on Steam on Wednesday 11th April 2018. Just 3 days from posting this!

As long as there are no issues with the submitted build it should release early morning PDT and around 9am in Europe. 

I hope you enjoy our tale.



Thanks for all the support and encouragement.
Nicholas Spargo
